reports.report_type_printed: Seven days preceding the General Election
reports.notes: Typed (fillable form, printed and scanned) - all figures are machine text, hence high confidence. MISALIGNED FORM, recorded but NOT reconciled: the Line 1 and Line 2 'Column B - Year-to-Date Total' cells are EMPTY, while three large figures (7,490.00 / 5792.01 / 1697.99) are printed at the Column B position inside the CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED, EXPENDITURES MADE and BALANCE SUMMARY section-header bands directly above their lines. These are very likely the filer's Column B entries rendered one row high by the fillable form, but that is an inference, so contrib_cumulative / expend_cumulative are left blank and the three stray figures are recorded verbatim under their own keys for the reader to judge. Dates disagree between pages: the cover signature is dated 10/29/2018, the summary page's 'Date of Report' box reads 10/30/18; report_date takes the cover signature. The clerk's receipt stamp reads 'OCT 30 PM 1:56'. Summary page is Page 1 of 1, Last Name 'Powers'. The filer typed no fax number.

contributions.anchor: Column A 'Total this Period' line 1 TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED (7,490.00) on the p2 SUMMARY PAGE, which equals Schedule A's own printed 'Subtotal for this page' 7,490.00 and its 'Total Contributions Received (Sum of subtotals from all Schedule A pages)' 7,490.00, and is repeated at summary lines 4 and 5
contributions.detail: 11 Schedule A rows sum to 5000.00 + 250.00 + 20.00 + 1500.00 + 50.00 + 50.00 + 400.00 + 50.00 + 50.00 + 20.00 + 100.00 = 7,490.00 exactly = the schedule's printed page subtotal = its printed total = the cover's promoted PER-PERIOD Column A cell. Column B (Year-to-Date) is EMPTY on this filing — the filer left the whole cumulative column blank — so there is no cumulative figure to confuse with the period one.
